beats.say: Five Grammy nominations went to KPop Demon Hunters Cast for the movie soundtrack.
That is five chances at music's highest honor, matching what major artists earn in half a decade.
The soundtrack album dropped on 20 June 2025 under Republic Records alongside the Netflix release.
Its breakout track Golden went on to win Best Song Written for Visual Media.
That single win created history, becoming the very first K-pop song ever to earn a Grammy.
Variety reports that Netflix and AEG Presents are now expanding that success into a live global concert tour.
